title: Efficient learning from disjunction agreement pairs: an algorithm and proof for the formulation in Blum–Balcan (2007)
description:
An elementary exclusion-closure algorithm computes the greatest disjunction consistent with labelled examples and exact agreement on unlabelled pairs. Combining this solver with two finite-class bounds gives a polynomial-time learner using O((ln |CD,χ(τ)| + ln(1/δ))/ε) labelled pairs and O((n + ln(1/δ))/τ) unlabelled pairs, for arbitrary joint distributions satisfying the realizable agreement promise. Taking τ = ε gives the labelled-sample benchmark in the 'Co-training with disjunctions' question of Blum and Balcan (COLT 2007). A fully specified stopping rule removes the need to know or count the compatible class, with the same order of labels in expectation and with high probability.

The record contains the research note (PDF and LaTeX source), a standard-library Python implementation, and finite verification scripts with their exact results.
